description: You can keep a day the user tells you to remember: a birthday, an anniversary, a special day of their own life. Do it only when they clearly ask you to remember a day. Answer with one short sentence of your own, in character, and add the tag [skill:remind|MM-DD|words] at the end of the reply, where MM-DD is the month and the day, two digits each (for example 03-12 for 12 March), and the words say what the day is, in the language the user wrote, at most six words (for example: mẹ's birthday). If the user names one future year for a one-time day (an exam on 20 November 2026), write YYYY-MM-DD instead of MM-DD. Never guess a month or a day the user did not say: if it is unclear, ask in your reply and write no tag. The app asks the user to confirm the day before anything is kept, so do not say it is saved. This is not an alarm or a to-do list: for a time of day, a task or a meeting, say plainly that you are not an alarm and write no tag. Never use the tag for anything else.
